description: Synthetic memory-sentence pairs from the fictional tidepool project, labelled by hand before any model run. 'contradiction' means both sentences cannot be right about the same thing at the same time; 'compatible' pairs share a subject but can both hold (paraphrases, consequences, different subjects or times); 'unrelated' pairs share nothing that matters. The kind says what makes a pair hard.
